_comment: Copy this file to system/interests.json and customize to your own interests. Scripts and prompt templates read from interests.json to personalize filtering and knowledge extraction.

rss_filter._comment: Rules used by update_freshrss.py for keyword-based pre-filtering of RSS items. Each rule has a label, a score delta, and a list of keyword patterns matched against title+source.

rss_taste_profile._comment: Natural-language taste profile injected into the LLM-based RSS filter prompt (system/templates/rss-filter-prompt.md). Edit these lists to match your interests.
high_priority: AI agents, tool use, context engineering, reasoning workflows
LLM systems and training: scaling, parallelism, GPU, optimizers, interpretability
Post-training: RLHF, GRPO, reasoning data, behavior shaping
Personal infrastructure: self-hosted knowledge and automation systems
preferred_style: Setup guides, playbooks, implementation details, architecture trade-offs, benchmarks
Material that connects theory with practice
Material that helps build, operate, maintain, or evaluate a system
weak_signals: Single-use entertainment or low-context consumer links
default_downranks: Generic AI news or launch coverage without technical depth
Prompt tips without workflow, evaluation, or system context
Consumer electronics reviews unrelated to personal systems
Lifestyle or entertainment content with no clear operational value

paper_filter._comment: Research interest profile injected into the HF paper filter prompt (system/templates/hf-paper-filter-prompt.md).
highest_priority: Reinforcement learning, RLHF, GRPO, reward modeling, post-training, reasoning behavior shaping
Agents, tool use, coding agents, agent architectures, environment interaction, agent evaluation
Mechanistic interpretability, circuit analysis, representation analysis, internal dynamics
secondary: LLM systems work that directly supports the topics above
Work on reasoning, self-verification, or alignment with concrete methodological depth
preferred_style: Strong experimental design, benchmarks, or evaluation methodology
Papers that expose an actionable idea or reusable framing
default_downranks: Generic foundation model news with little method detail
Pure application papers unrelated to the interests above
Broad multimodal, vision, graphics, or biomedical papers unless method is reusable

paper_knowledge._comment: Focus areas injected into the HF paper knowledge extraction prompt (system/templates/hf-paper-knowledge-prompt.md).
user_focus: Mechanistic interpretability and internal model analysis

related_topic_links._comment: Mapping from interest labels to wiki topic page paths (relative to repo root). Used by update_hf_daily_papers.py to add cross-links in generated source files.

default_topic_buckets._comment: Default topic slugs that CLAUDE.md suggests as starting points. Adjust to your own areas of interest.
